classification_notes: A (mathematically impossible at R=40): the adjacent families need a 40 mm quarter turn plus >=2R=80 mm straight runs between double-corner segments; with the canonical port at s_x and the target row q_y the reachable set is the complement of the infeasible regions in the grid above. The final quarter turn into the x=150 edge must be centred at x<=110 and at y = q_y +/- R, which forces q_y >= R (approach from below) or the approach-from-above shape that needs >= 2R of horizontal travel before the descent; that is what blocks the s_x >= 40 / q_y < 40 and s_x >= 120 regions.

B (template coverage): every gap in the grid was re-tested with the full family set (L, TURN_S, SHIFT_TURN, Z3, Z5, LEFT); adding more families does not fill the mathematically empty regions, but exotic multi-S chains are not enumerated - recorded as residual template risk.
C (program error): ruled out for the reported families by validate() re-checks and by the independent validator round-trip on emitted geometry.
